newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil May vehicle output up 16.76 pct - Anfavea.
newsitem.headline: Brazil May vehicle output up 16.76 pct - Anfavea.

text.p: Brazil produced 182,557 vehicles in May, or 16.76 percent more than in the same month of 1996, Brazil's Motor Manufactures Association (Anfavea) said on Thursday.
But production last month fell 5.45 percent from April, when 193,081 vehicles were produced, an Anfavea spokesman said.
In the first five months of 1997, Brazil produced 836,649 vehicles, or 20.73 percent more than in the same period a year earlier, he said.

Last month, vehicle makers sold 146,789 units in Brazil, 13.33 percent more than in May 1996, when 129,524 vehicles were sold. Last month's sales fell 5.72 percent compared with April, when 155,689 vehicles were sold in the domestic market, he said.
Brazilian exports rose 40.54 percent to 34,964 vehicles last month from 24,879 in May 1996, he said.
